steps.say: Leukodystrophies are genetic diseases of white matter that regress a growing child or cripple a young adult. Development stalls, then walking with speech with vision is lost in that order. Magnetic resonance shows symmetric white matter change that spares the cortex, which separates them from acquired demyelination. Meeting milestones then losing them is the red flag that starts the workup.
steps.tx: **Leukodystrophies** are genetic white matter diseases that **regress** a developing child. Milestones are met then lost: gait, speech, vision. **MRI** shows **symmetric white matter** change sparing cortex, unlike the asymmetric lesions of acquired demyelination. **Regression after normal development** is the red flag that starts testing.

steps.say: Metachromatic leukodystrophy is caused by failed myelin lipid breakdown and usually presents with a waddling gait in late infancy. Reflexes vanish early while the child still understands everything, which is cruelly distinctive. Arylsulfatase A activity is measured in white cells, and urine testing supports the diagnosis. Transplant before symptoms is the only move that changes the course, so affected siblings are screened at birth.
steps.tx: **Metachromatic leukodystrophy** from **arylsulfatase A** deficiency presents with **gait waddling** in late infancy. **Reflexes vanish** while understanding is spared. **White cell enzyme** assay with urine testing confirms it. **Transplant before symptoms** is the only course changer; siblings are screened at birth.

steps.say: Krabbe disease presents in infants with extreme irritability, stiffness and blindness, and most die before two years. Optic atrophy with deafness with spasticity follows a normal start of months. Galactocerebrosidase activity confirms it, and transplant helps only presymptomatic newborns found by screening. Late onset forms weaken the legs in older children and progress far slower.
steps.tx: **Krabbe disease** from **galactocerebrosidase** deficiency gives an **irritable stiff blind** infant after normal early months. **Optic atrophy with deafness** with spasticity follows. Enzyme assay confirms it. **Transplant** helps only **presymptomatic** screened newborns. **Late onset** forms cause slow leg weakness in older children.

steps.say: Adrenoleukodystrophy strikes schoolgoing boys with falling grades with clumsiness, and the adrenals fail alongside the brain. Very long chain fatty acids are raised in blood, which is the screening test for every affected family. On magnetic resonance there is back to front white matter change with contrast at the edge. Transplant halts early brain disease, and adrenal replacement is lifelong.
steps.tx: **Adrenoleukodystrophy** strikes boys with **school failure** and clumsiness; adrenals fail too. **Very long chain fatty acids** are raised and screen families. **MRI** shows back to front change with edge enhancement. **Transplant** halts early disease. **Adrenal replacement** with family screening is lifelong.

steps.say: Canavan disease swells the head with N acetyl aspartate that poisons myelin, and the infant is floppy with poor head control. Aspartoacylase gene testing confirms it, and magnetic resonance spectroscopy shows the tall N A A peak. No treatment reverses it, so care is supportive with seizure control with physiotherapy. Alexander disease also enlarges the head but scars the frontal lobes with Rosenthal fibres.
steps.tx: **Canavan disease** from **aspartoacylase** deficiency gives **megalencephaly with floppy** infancy. **MR spectroscopy** shows a tall **NAA peak**. No treatment reverses it; care is supportive. **Alexander disease** (GFAP, Rosenthal fibres) also enlarges the head but scars **frontal** lobes first, and seizures follow.

steps.say: Vanishing white matter disease melts with every fever, so a viral illness permanently steps the child down. E I F two B genes cause it, and the white matter literally vanishes leaving fluid on follow up scans. With Pelizaeus Merzbacher disease, newborn boys develop nystagmus with stridor from P L P one gene faults. Girls are silent carriers in X linked forms, so the pedigree predicts the gene.
steps.tx: **Vanishing white matter** disease steps down with **every fever** (EIF2B genes); white matter **vanishes into fluid** on scans. **Pelizaeus Merzbacher** (PLP1) gives newborn boys **nystagmus with stridor**. **X linked** pedigrees point to PLP1 and ABCD genes; **consanguinity** points to recessive enzymes.

steps.say: Every regressing child follows the same testing order, and adrenal testing in boys is never skipped. Magnetic resonance with spectroscopy is done first to map the pattern, then enzyme assays with very long chain fatty acids with gene panels close in. Adrenal axis with gonadal review is added for X linked suspects. Adult spastic paraparesis with white matter change is worked up the same way, because late onset forms exist.
steps.tx: **Workup order** is fixed: **MRI with spectroscopy** first, then **enzyme assays, VLCFA and gene panels**. **Adrenal testing** is added for every boy, since crisis kills quickly. **Nerve conduction** with eye review separates peripheral plus retinal forms. **Adult spastic** paraparesis with white change gets the same workup for late onset disease.

steps.say: Transplant halts early metachromatic with Krabbe with adrenoleukodystrophy, but only before symptoms appear, which is why newborn screening matters. Lorenzo oil with diet slows pure adrenal forms without brain disease. Everything else is supportive: seizures controlled, spasticity released, feeding secured and schooling adapted. Genetic counselling with prenatal testing protects the next pregnancy.
steps.tx: **Transplant before symptoms** halts early MLD, Krabbe and ALD; after onset it cannot restore myelin. **Dietary oil therapy** slows adrenal forms without brain disease. **Supportive care** controls seizures, spasticity and feeding through the team. **Genetic counselling** with prenatal testing protects future pregnancies.

steps.say: Supportive care is the mainstay for symptomatic children, and it is delivered by a team that plans years ahead. Spasticity is eased with physiotherapy with orthotics, while seizures are controlled with standard drugs chosen for least sedation. Feeding is secured early with gastrostomy before aspiration harms the lungs. Schooling is adapted with home support, and parents are counselled at every visit.
steps.tx: **Supportive care** carries symptomatic children: **physiotherapy with orthotics** for spasticity, least sedating **seizure control**, early **gastrostomy** before aspiration, adapted schooling with home support. **Parents are counselled** at every visit. **Palliative planning** starts early and is revisited as needs change with growth.

steps.say: The tragic trap is reassuring a clumsy boy with falling grades as lazy while transplant window closes. The second trap is missing adrenal failure, which kills in a crisis that fluids with sugar with steroids reverse. Fever is cooled aggressively in vanishing white matter disease, and live vaccines with dehydration are avoided. Carrier mothers need counselling before the next conception, not after.
steps.tx: **Exam traps:** clumsy boy with falling grades is **ALD until tested**, not lazy. **Adrenal crisis** kills and reverses with fluids, sugar and steroids. **Fever** steps down vanishing white matter; cool aggressively. **Transplant after symptoms** cannot restore myelin, so newborn screening of siblings is the real lifesaver. **Consanguinity** with regression means recessive enzymes.

steps.say: For the exam, the facts to lock in are arylsulfatase for metachromatic, galactocerebrosidase for Krabbe, very long chain fatty acids for adrenoleukodystrophy, N A A peak for Canavan, frontal scars for Alexander, and fever steps for vanishing white matter. Transplant works only before symptoms and adrenal failure needs lifelong replacement. Memorise the facts in this table exactly as written.
steps.tx: **High yield for the exam:** **arylsulfatase A** marks metachromatic; **galactocerebrosidase** marks Krabbe. Raised **VLCFA** marks ALD in boys with school failure. **NAA peak** marks Canavan; **frontal scars** mark Alexander. **Transplant before symptoms** is the rule; adrenal replacement is lifelong and crisis cover is taught.
